name: strays
description: Cathode, the stray cat with a bionic front paw that lives in Dray Lane. Hides by being genuinely elsewhere (a real, exitless den zone that is also its home_zone, so the engine's own boot placement and respawn both return it to hiding without knowing this plugin exists), surfaces into an occupied lane tile for 45-120s at a time and performs one of 32 gated behaviours per beat, and can be turned up early with `search`. Petting pays sanity on a 6-hour cooldown; killing it is easy, permitted, costs the killer and every witness sanity, sours every NPC in the room, and takes the cat out of the world for 24 hours. It remembers who did which, permanently: the pet count and the kill count are player flags, and a killer can never pet it or find it again.
inputMatchers: Cathode! / Here Cathode! / call cathode / summon cathode / pspsps — shouting for her. Registered as a matcher, not a command, because bare `call` and `summon` belong to gametable's poker table and plugins do not beat each other; every pattern but `pspsps` carries her name, so poker keeps its verbs.
